answer: Submitting an answer locks 57 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The nebula escrow is released only against a kernel receipt, and the gale audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 257 aliases means carrying 240 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 6 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
